clips.text: Your turn. Give Pixel Reel anything wordy, and it comes back as a pixel reel, read out by me.
It can be a link to an article. The transcript of a meeting. A letter you've been sent. Or just a question, like, how do bees make honey.
Press Make a pixel reel now. Beside me there is My notes. Type it in, say it out loud, or paste it in.
Then press Make my next reel. Claude writes the scenes, I read them out, and it plays in about a minute.
Every reel has My notes beside it too, so you can keep asking. And all your reels are under Your reels.
